mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which contain the nutrient elements in the form of compounds which are directly assimilated by plants."
Direct fertilizers are those which contain the nutrient elements in the form of compounds which are directly assimilated by plants.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a good catalyst for many reactions and is also used to produce sulphates, such as ammonium sulphate, sodium sulphate and aluminum sulphate."
Sulphuric acid is a good catalyst for many reactions and is also used to produce sulphates, such as ammonium sulphate, sodium sulphate and aluminum sulphate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a strong inorganic acid that is used in many industrial processes."
Hydrochloric acid is a strong inorganic acid that is used in many industrial processes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the key components of the heavy industry."
Industrial processes are the key components of the heavy industry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the older of the two processes."
The lead- chamber process is the older of the two processes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major division in the science of extractive metallurgy."
The processing of minerals is a major division in the science of extractive metallurgy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used without further treatment other than breaking it up to the desired size."
The product is used without further treatment other than breaking it up to the desired size.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process in which two metal elements are melted together in a precise combination to form a specific material or alloy."
Alloying is a process in which two metal elements are melted together in a precise combination to form a specific material or alloy.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a naturally occurring homogeneous solid, inorganically formed with a definite chemical composition and ordered arrangement (Mason et al. 1968)."
A mineral is a naturally occurring homogeneous solid, inorganically formed with a definite chemical composition and ordered arrangement (Mason et al. 1968).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an electrolytic cell used in the manufacture of magnesium from fused magnesium chloride."
The Dow cell is an electrolytic cell used in the manufacture of magnesium from fused magnesium chloride.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first step in the solid mineral extractive process."
Minerals processing is the first step in the solid mineral extractive process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a chemical process in which impurities are removed from metals by oxidation at high temperatures."
Pyrometallurgical oxidation is a chemical process in which impurities are removed from metals by oxidation at high temperatures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the site of reduction. v."
The cathode is the site of reduction. v.
fib: ______ is a slowly hardening mineral, helenite and magnesium spinel are inert admixtures deteriorating the properties of high alumina cement.
Dicalcium silicate
Dicalcium silicate is a slowly hardening mineral, helenite and magnesium spinel are inert admixtures deteriorating the properties of high alumina cement.
______ is the industry that produces chlorine and alkali, sodium hydroxide (caustic soda), sodium carbonate (soda ash) and its derivatives and compounds based on calcium oxide (lime).
chlor-alkali industry

The chlor-alkali industry is the industry that produces chlorine and alkali, sodium hydroxide (caustic soda), sodium carbonate (soda ash) and its derivatives and compounds based on calcium oxide (lime).
______ is an azeotrope with water at a concentration of 68% HNO3, which is the ordinary concentrated nitric acid.
Commercially available nitric acid
Commercially available nitric acid is an azeotrope with water at a concentration of 68% HNO3, which is the ordinary concentrated nitric acid.
______ is a combination of oxygen liberated from alumina, with the carbon of the anodes, which are consumed with the formation of CO and CO2.
ensuing reaction
The ensuing reaction is a combination of oxygen liberated from alumina, with the carbon of the anodes, which are consumed with the formation of CO and CO2.
______ is a rapid hardening hydraulic cement.
Aluminous cement like Portland cement
Aluminous cement like Portland cement is a rapid hardening hydraulic cement.
______ is a binder, a substance used for construction that sets, hardens, and adheres to other materials to bind them together.
cement
A cement is a binder, a substance used for construction that sets, hardens, and adheres to other materials to bind them together.
______ is the branch of chemistry which deals the method of extraction of metals from their ores and preparing them for use.
Metallurgy
Metallurgy is the branch of chemistry which deals the method of extraction of metals from their ores and preparing them for use.
______ is a strong acid, the major component of gastric acid and of wide industrial use.
Hydrochloric acid or muriatic acid
Hydrochloric acid or muriatic acid is a strong acid, the major component of gastric acid and of wide industrial use.
______ are the diaphragm cell process, the mercury cell process, and the membrane cell process.
three processes
The three processes are the diaphragm cell process, the mercury cell process, and the membrane cell process.
______ is any laboratory or industrial activity in which products are chemically reacted with each other to form new products.
chemical process
A chemical process is any laboratory or industrial activity in which products are chemically reacted with each other to form new products.
______ are those substances which are added to the soil in order to improve its chemical, mechanical or biological properties.
Indirect fertilizers
Indirect fertilizers are those substances which are added to the soil in order to improve its chemical, mechanical or biological properties.
______ is a composite material consisting of aggregate (gravel and sand), cement and water.
Concrete
Concrete is a composite material consisting of aggregate (gravel and sand), cement and water.
______ is used by masons to clean finished brick work.
HCl
HCl is used by masons to clean finished brick work.
